integrity: Closed-form probability, all-s analytic proof and large-s dominated-convergence asymptotic; exact rational and independent sampling checks are supplementary. Scientific originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact probability restricted to a two-dimensional trial subspace coupled through one outside direction, with real independent Gaussian sketches and exact arithmetic; no universality over general SPD matrices, structure-preserving sketches, or an iterative eigensolver convergence theorem.
title: Exponential suppression of nonreal sketched Ritz pairs in a fixed symmetric model
